interface.signature: def captainAmerica(N: int, M: int, V: List[List[int]]) -> int:

preconditions.description: N is the number of rooms (1 ≤ N ≤ 30000) and M is the number of gates (1 ≤ M ≤ 200000).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N and 1 <= q <= N for [p, q] in V)
preconditions.description: Each gate in V is a pair of integers (p, q) where p and q are valid room numbers (1 ≤ p, q ≤ N).
The length of V is exactly M, representing the number of gates.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len({room for room in range(1, N + 1) if all(any(has_path(room, x) for x in range(1, N + 1)) for x in range(1, N + 1))})
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of rooms from which every other room in the maze is reachable (directly or indirectly).

invariants.expression: has_path == lambda a, b: any(has_path(a, x) and has_path(x, b) for x in range(1, N + 1)) or a == b or any(a == x[0] and x[1] == b for x in V)
invariants.description: has_path(a, b) is true if there exists a path from room a to room b, either directly or indirectly.
